# Agent Plugins for Codex and Claude Code

Reusable agent workflows for code review, documentation, project memory, product decisions, writing, and publishing. Install the collection once, then ask your agent to use a skill by name.

[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills?sort=semver)](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/releases/latest) [![Build](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/actions/workflows/regenerate-skills.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/actions/workflows/regenerate-skills.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

## Quick start

### Codex

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills --ref master
codex plugin add agent-plugins@valentin-agent-plugins
codex plugin list
```

### Claude Code

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills@master
claude plugin install agent-plugins@valentin-agent-plugins
```

If Claude Code is already running, use `/reload-plugins` after installation.

### Try it

```text
Use code-review to review my uncommitted changes.
Use audit-docs to find stale documentation references.
Use business-viability-assessment to assess this product idea.
```

- [`clean-code-comments`](agent-plugins/skills/clean-code-comments/SKILL.md) — Remove redundant comments without changing behavior.
- [`code-review`](agent-plugins/skills/code-review/SKILL.md) — Review changes for bugs, regressions, and test gaps.

- [`plan-review`](agent-plugins/skills/plan-review/SKILL.md) — Validate implementation plans before coding begins.

## How it works

Canonical skill definitions live in [`agent-plugins/skills/`](agent-plugins/skills/). The generator creates complete platform distributions under [`codex/skills/`](codex/skills/) and [`claude/skills/`](claude/skills/). Shared resources live in [`agent-plugins/shared/`](agent-plugins/shared/).

Codex reads [`.codex-plugin/plugin.json`](.codex-plugin/plugin.json), and Claude Code reads [`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`](.claude-plugin/plugin.json). Edit canonical sources rather than generated distribution copies.

## Contributing and development

Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, repository layout, and pull-request guidance. After changing a canonical skill or shared resource, regenerate and verify the distributions:

```bash
python scripts/generate_skill_wrappers.py --clean
python scripts/generate_skill_wrappers.py --check --clean --strict-links
python scripts/validate_skills.py
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

Releases are published from [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/actions) and collected on the [releases page](https://github.com/ValentinNikolaev/agent-skills/releases).
